title: Your next AI agent needs an attention budget
seoTitle: AI Agent ROI: Count the Human Attention It Takes
description: Measure review time, corrections, and interruptions before expanding an AI agent. A practical pilot for business owners who want dependable capacity.
deck: Before you give an agent more work, measure the review, corrections, and interruptions it asks of your people.
subtitle: Count the human work first
cardTitle: Your next AI agent needs an attention budget
imageAlt: Your next AI agent needs an attention budget. Count review, corrections and interruptions.

attention-budget.label: Illustrative comparison of human time for the same 40 accepted handoffs: eight hours before AI and five hours with AI, leaving three hours of potential capacity. A separate planning example budgets 90 review minutes at three minutes per handoff.
attention-budget.caption: Illustrative example: the same 40 accepted customer handoffs. These are hypothetical figures, not measured client results.
